about: Hand labels of round-1 reviewer items on the corpus fixtures (docs/fixtures/corpus.json), each judged against its fixture's post_rev. Keys: #n stored blocker, #en evidence-demoted, #hn hedge-demoted, numbered as eval_harness.corpus score lists them. An item may carry several known-bug ids when its claim covers several. Labelled 2026-10-23 for ADR-0002's fourteenth measurement (the corpus baseline). The sixteenth measurement's fresh sample (records 20261024_033005 to 20261024_041842, sample 'fresh') was labelled the same way, before any judge variant was replayed on it.

classes.unlisted: valid but minor: a change the same fix commit reverted, not a functional bug
classes.invariant-elsewhere: false: a removed or missing check whose invariant another function enforces in the post-state
classes.thread-confusion: false: a race claimed on state only one thread touches, or that is set before the worker starts
classes.bounds-fixed-array: false: an out-of-bounds claim on a fixed-size, zero-initialized array
classes.deletion: false: removed code or a removed comment presented as current
classes.other-fp: false: any other claim the post-state refutes

notes.poll_override_90020bd: In the post-state (5ec331c) parse_query rejects ?poll= without ?filter=, and resolve_channels then builds exactly one channel from the filter, so chans[0] is always the poll's channel; chans is a fixed array besides. Every claim of a missing channel check for poll mode is invariant-elsewhere.
notes.ecu_support_7d297b4: ecuio_dropped_request_t.request is uint8_t[3] with length 2 or 3, and the support struct is value-initialized, so request[0] is in bounds. pollChannelSupport and applyConnectedState both run on the GUI thread (the coalescing timer and the queued connect completion).
notes.decode_length_b47687c: c7477e #4: the missing m_lastReportedDropped reset on connect is benign. The first notifyDropped compares a zeroed m_droppedFrames with the old value and emits, which is what refreshes the UI; with the reset the stale count would stay on screen. Labelled other-fp. The typed setSignalSet parameter is labelled unlisted: b47687c reverted it as a FIX, but a void* on an internal C++ method is not a functional bug.
notes.fresh_rule: A claim that states a known bug's defect is credited to it even when a side detail is wrong (68d66c #e1 calls the internal header an ABI; 68d66c #e3 says the helper checked BUFFER_OVERFLOW; 0390ed #3 calls the inlined code orphaned). A claim whose asserted consequence is false is not credited even when it points at the buggy line (c1e188 #3 says scheduler and poll both run; the worker's branches are exclusive).
notes.decode_length_b47687c_fresh: 7a3f78 #1 and 2964be #3 claim a data race on m_stagingBuffer; handleFrameInternal is queued to the GUI thread, where the coalescing timer also runs. 2964be #4: m_lastReportedDropped is updated in the post-state. 2964be #e1: the post-state (b975457) builds without the signals.h include in the header.
notes.v14_nineteenth: Sample 'v14' (records 20261026_014403 to 20261026_040210; the retried fcda47 and the pilot's 011519 and 011610 are not labeled), labeled before scoring by the same rules. 06248d #1 says the inlined code uses <= and changes the result at the cap: false, other-fp. 896c70 #2: err is used after the join. 5e7ae7 #1: on failure connectCoreOnly destroys the session (as 2e95fa #e1). e6c961 #1: m_session is set in applyConnectedState. daaeb5 #4: the only Qt::QueuedConnection removed went with the drop-notify call; the frame invokeMethod is unchanged. b53474 #e1: updateValues reads values. A claim that the payloadHex clamp was removed is payload_length_unclamped whatever line it quotes.
notes.v15_twentieth: Sample 'v15' (records 20261026_152132 to 20261026_174138; the retried 9116d9, 7a11c9, c247d4, 187a73, e7d68a, 67e86a and the pilot's 151439 and 151617 are not labeled), labeled before scoring by the same rules. poll_override: req[6] is exactly what build_mode01_request writes (a 4-byte id, mode, PID), so every claim that it is too small is other-fp; 20a19c #3 says poll now forces non-scheduler mode, a false consequence, other-fp; ceac6d #h1 (resource waste) and 182913 #h2 (error code) are other-fp. connect_start: 9bbf58 #e3 is false, connectSession calls applyConnectedState. decode_length: the removed clamp (len) served payloadHex and the decode alike, so 38a5a0 #1 to #3 are payload_length_unclamped; e99c5a #4, the emit the fix added to forceFrameCountForTesting, is unlisted. ecu_support: df0d13 #3, pid_bitmap[(pid - 1) / 8] with pid <= 0xFF indexes at most 31 of 32, bounds-fixed-array; 8b68e1 #1, disconnectSession takes m_session on the GUI thread, thread-confusion.
notes.v16_twenty_first: Sample 'v16' (records 20261026_200617 to 20261026_211854; the retried 1f7900 and 78f09a and the pilot's 200203 and 200452 are not labeled), labeled before scoring by the same rules. poll_override: a claim that the worker picks the wrong channel for the poll PID is invariant-elsewhere, as a missing-channel claim is; 712a1f #e1 (the worker's and attach's sched_mode disagree, undefined behavior) names no poll consequence and is other-fp; 9f52fe #2 (an ABI boundary on channel ordering) is other-fp. trusted_count: a claim that the removed helper missed ERR_BUFFER_OVERFLOW is count_under_error, as in v15 (a0ed9f).
notes.v11.1_poll_runaway_diagnostic: Sample 'v11.1_poll' (records 20261026_225640 to 20261026_234601, v11.1, poll_override only; collected for backlog #19's runaway diagnostic, which scored no blockers; the retried 17a355 and 6cb4e4 are not labeled), labeled by the same rules. A claim that the sched_mode change lets the scheduler run or changes which mode is used when poll is set is poll_ignored (619e0c #2, 'poll handling not updated - inconsistent behavior', names no false consequence and is credited). 6ee07d #2 says parse_query's rx_id check is insufficient: false, invariant-elsewhere. b9eaaf #e1 says ?txid= can supply a channel, a wrong side detail; it states the parse-time rejection and is credited. d92498 #1 (req[6] too small for CAN-FD) is other-fp, as in v15.
notes.b22_twenty_second: Samples 'b22_laguna' (laguna-xs-2.1, the concurrent control) and 'b22_qwen' (qwen3-coder:30b), records 20261027_131621 to 20261027_143555 (ADR-0002, twenty-second measurement, Stage 1; the retried 120882 and Stage 0's bridge records are not labeled), labeled before either arm was scored, by the same rules; the records name their model, so the labels are not blind. backoff_clamp: a claim that the inlined condition is wrong is backoff_overshoot, as 5890c6 and 294ce8 #1 were. trusted_count: the claim's content decides, as before: a count left untouched on an error is count_under_error, a stale or phantom replay is static_batch_replay. poll_override: a claim that attach lost its poll channel check, or that chans[0] is the wrong or a missing channel, is invariant-elsewhere. connect_start: credited when the claim says the session leaks, dangles or outlives a bridge destroyed mid-connect, or that the destructor can no longer clean it up (as 77f026 #h1 and b90266 were). Not credited: a race between onFrame and applyConnectedState (5a2e6a #1) or a start that is 'not thread-safe' before the GUI state is ready (9ad3b4 #e2), since onFrame returns until applyConnectedState sets m_connected last, with release ordering; and 1406df #2, the queued lambda touching a destroyed this, since a queued call is dropped with its context object. All three are other-fp. decode_length: a claim that drops are counted but never reported is drops_unreported_when_saturated, a claim that the merge was removed is staging_clear_per_frame, as before. ecu_support: m_channelCount is clamped to ECUIO_SESSION_INFO_MAX_CHANNELS by std::min, so 87a5c0 #h1 is bounds-fixed-array.
